notes:
Summary: Closed-lost — decision announced 2026-02-12. Wildwood went with Together.ai for on-prem agent + steep discount. Key reasons: aggressive pricing, simpler on-prem installer, existing reference (adtech customer), and internal budget freeze only partially — vendor economics won.

Call notes (shorthand):
- 2026-01-22 kickoff: scoped ingestion volumes ~150M embeddings/month, peak chat QPS target 120/s, 99th p95 latency target <200ms for short chat flows.
- POC plan: 2-week on-prem eval, sample dataset for ranking model, embedding batch throughput run. SE to assist with quantized model layout.
- Security: requested full SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, KMS workflow, and audit log push to their Splunk. Security ops flagged "network egress" and key custodian (HSM) as blockers.
- Pricing negotiation: Wildwood wanted committed reserved pricing for Dedicated/Private; Together offered 40% discount + multi-year commit; Redwood pricing sat ~25% higher in ARR model.
- Internal: champion (VP of ML) rotated to another role mid-POC; no clear exec sponsor after Jan. 30. Account contacts became slower after.
- Final: Wildwood legal pushed Together contract 02/10, signed 02/12. Reached out after - AE + SE did wrap call 02/14.

Stance/feedback: "We liked the runtime and batching ideas but the deployment tooling and price point were deciding factors." — Head of ML (paraphrase).

Artifacts: drive links above, Fireflies meeting ff-2026-01-22-9163 (POC kickoff).

use_case_summary: Productionizing conversational support + ad-ranking pipeline. Core needs: high-throughput embeddings (batch & streaming), sub-200ms short-chat latency, deterministic reranking for CTR-sensitive flows. Heavy emphasis on private deployment, KMS/HSM for key custody, and audit pipelines into SIEM. Cost-sensitive at scale — expected 100-200 GPU-hours/day equivalent. Wanted model pinning + automatic fallback for degraded nodes.
next_steps_summary: Post-loss actions: collect formal win/loss notes, ask for debrief with buyer (AE to request 30-minute feedback), update pricing competitiveness doc, add Together on competitive tracker, keep on 6-month nurture cadence in case of churn or future RFP.
loss_reason_summary: Primary: price/performance tradeoff at procurement stage. Together provided aggressive discount + simpler on-prem installer; security concerns (HSM integration complexity) slowed Redwood and gave competitor time. Secondary: loss of internal champion mid-POC and company budget re-prioritization.
